cut: RFH Brink/Coxon, VIRAL CUT v1 stills (30 Oct). Pentagon frontier-AI contracts ask the four AI companies to forecast the risks of their own models. A contract folder stamped PENTAGON; four contracts (LAB A-D, no names); the clause RISK FORECASTING · THREAT IDEATION highlighted; the page becomes an exam the company marks itself: ticks, A+, SELF-GRADED. Disclosure tag at the end: made with Anthropic's tools, Anthropic is one of the four.
argument: The Pentagon's July 2025 frontier-AI contracts (up to $200M each, four companies) ask each company to forecast the risks of its own AI; critics, among them the AI Now Institute, call relying on vendors to assess their own products a conflict of interest.
syntax: '/' breaks a line, [word] is the pop word; in Japanese a space marks a reveal segment and is never drawn

text.en: The Pentagon / bought AI from / [four] companies.
text.ja: 国防総省は [4社]から / AIを 購入。

captions.source: CDAO release (ai.mil, July 2025) and DefenseScoop 14 Jul 2025: contracts with a ceiling of up to $200M each to Anthropic, Google, OpenAI and xAI, to develop agentic AI workflows. 'Bought AI' = contracts for AI prototypes and services; the ceiling is a maximum, not a confirmed payout (tag says UP TO). Breaking Defense dates OpenAI's award a month earlier (June 2025); the tag says JULY 2025, as The Intercept and most coverage do.

text.en: Each must / [forecast] the risks / of its own AI.
text.ja: 各社は 自社AIの / リスクを [予測]する。

captions.source: The Intercept, 8 Sep 2026 (theintercept.com/2026/09/08/military-ai-weapons-contracts-openai-anthropic-google/), from 400+ pages obtained in a FOIA lawsuit: the contracts require each company to supply 'risk forecasting' and 'threat ideation' on dangers its own future products might pose. Multiple outlets carrying the story agree (IBTimes, AI Weekly, heise). Verified from search summaries only; the article itself was not opened (no fetch tool in this session). DoD and OpenAI say certain OpenAI pages (the 'minimal refusal rates' wording) were drafts incorrectly provided; that dispute is not about this clause and the film does not use those pages.

text.en: Critics call it / a conflict / of [interest].
text.ja: 批判派は / [利益相反]と 指摘。

captions.source: Heidy Khlaaf, AI Now Institute (chief AI scientist), quoted by The Intercept and in AI Now's own press note (ainowinstitute.org/news/press/ai-giants-work-hand-in-hand-with-the-pentagon-contracts-reveal): relying on the vendors to assess their own products' risks is a conflict of interest. A paraphrase: no quote marks on screen. 'Critics' (plural) because the tag names one: AI Now; other watchdogs have pressed for oversight (Warren letters, Jul 2026).

text.ja: 自分の [宿題]を / 自分で 採点。

captions.source: The station's line: the companies forecast the risks of their own products for the buyer (caption 2). A metaphor, not a claim about grades or scores in the contracts.

clause.ja: リスク予測 · 脅威の想定

post.en: Pentagon AI deals with OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and xAI (up to $200M each) ask each to forecast the risks of its own AI, per contracts The Intercept won in a FOIA suit. Critics call it a conflict of interest. Made with Anthropic's tools; Anthropic is one of the four. Who checks?
post.fi: Pentagonin tekoälysopimukset OpenAI:n, Anthropicin, Googlen ja xAI:n kanssa (enintään 200 M$) vaativat kutakin ennustamaan oman tekoälynsä riskit (The Intercept). Kriitikot puhuvat eturistiriidasta. Tehty Anthropicin työkaluilla; Anthropic on yksi neljästä. Kuka tarkastaa?
post.ja: 国防総省のAI契約（OpenAI、Anthropic、Google、xAI、各最大2億ドル）は、各社に自社AIのリスク予測を求める。The Interceptが情報公開訴訟で入手した文書による。批判派は利益相反と指摘。本作はAnthropicのツールで制作。Anthropicは4社の1つ。誰が確かめる？
